svg.title: Vasculitis: suspect it in a chronically unwell patient with several organs involved and no infection or cancer; a new headache over 50 points to giant cell arteritis, sinus, lung, kidney and nerve disease to ANCA-associated vasculitis, purpura on the legs to cutaneous leukocytoclastic vasculitis, and an identifiable cause to secondary vasculitis; each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and treatment in order
